scenes.text: Object 1: which unit best describes the mass or capacity of a bag of rice? Let us think carefully. Choose mass units for weight and capacity units for liquid containers. The answer is kg. Great work!
Object 2: which unit best describes the mass or capacity of a paperclip? Let us think carefully. Choose mass units for weight and capacity units for liquid containers. The answer is g. Great work!

Object 3: which unit best describes the mass or capacity of a bucket of water? Let us think carefully. Choose mass units for weight and capacity units for liquid containers. The answer is L. Great work!

Object 4: which unit best describes the mass or capacity of a tea spoon of water? Let us think carefully. Choose mass units for weight and capacity units for liquid containers. The answer is mL. Great work!
